recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It aligns the authoritative MessageHeader StructureDefinition with the applied Jira resolution and WGM minutes; no further core follow-up is needed unless InM later chooses to add separate Device-use guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-43530 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification R6 InM change request to extend MessageHeader.destination.receiver and MessageHeader.source.sender with additional actor resources. The final resolution required sender targets Practitioner, PractitionerRole, Device, Organization, Patient, and RelatedPerson; receiver targets Patient, RelatedPerson, Practitioner, PractitionerRole, Organization, CareTeam, and Device; and excluded Group and Person.
initial_application: Commit ae7a52d4774534d79d074a8e86cab733e11964c3 applied part of the issue by adding Patient to source.sender and Device, Organization, Patient, and RelatedPerson to destination.receiver, but it missed RelatedPerson on source.sender and CareTeam on destination.receiver. The stale source.sender comment sentence saying the element was proposed for removal in favor of Task also remained.
additional_context: The 2024-01-30 InM WGM minutes confirm the same 3-0-0 motion reflected in Jira. Later FHIR-44633 resolved the Device overlap by removing MessageHeader.destination.target rather than removing Device from destination.receiver, and that issue is already represented on the combined branch. Related Jira/Zulip/Confluence searches found no later conflicting final decision about dropping CareTeam from receiver or RelatedPerson from sender.
reconciliation: Edited build-scoped source/messageheader/structuredefinition-MessageHeader.xml to add CareTeam to MessageHeader.destination.receiver, add RelatedPerson to MessageHeader.source.sender, and remove only the stale source.sender sentence proposing removal in favor of Task.
